Why It Works for Sensitive Skin
30% Glycerin: Floods the skin with deep hydration and repairs a damaged skin barrier at a much higher concentration than most serums.
Soothing Additives: Contains allantoin, bisabolol, and prickly pear extract to calm redness, relieve tight or reactive skin, and speed up recovery.
National Eczema Association Seal: Officially recognized for safety and soothing support on ultra-dry and compromised skin barriers.
Fragrance-Free: Formulated without artificial colorants or added fragrance to minimize the risk of a reactive flare-up.
